body:
The template's Bun CI command scans the entire checkout. Its `bunfig.toml` contains only a comment claiming exclusions are unsupported. Bun supports `test.root`; without it, checked-in diagnostic snapshots, vendored examples or generated output containing test files execute as template tests.

Pinned affected sources:

- [bunfig.toml at 0a3957d](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/0a3957d8195271829aa3cd5adce58a98fe73be2b/bunfig.toml)
- [Bun workflow command](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/0a3957d8195271829aa3cd5adce58a98fe73be2b/.github/workflows/release.yml#L370)
- The current `bunfig.toml` was checked through the authenticated contents API on 2026-10-28 and still contains only those comments.

Minimal isolated reproduction (Bun 1.4.4; no dependencies):

```sh
fixture=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$fixture"
mkdir -p tests dev/log/reference
printf "import { test } from 'bun:test'; test('owned', () => {});\n" > tests/owned.test.js
printf "throw new Error('Archived reference must not execute');\n" > dev/log/reference/foreign.test.js
bun test --timeout 1000
# Exit 1: Bun executes the foreign test as well as the owned test.
printf '[test]\nroot = "./tests"\n' > bunfig.toml
bun test --timeout 1000
# Exit 0: only the owned test executes.
```

This caused actual Linux/Windows Bun CI failures while collecting revision-pinned template evidence in [meta-sovereign PR 44](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/pull/44). For example, job 122969274732 in [run 40730466733](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/actions/runs/40730466733/job/122969274732) executes `dev/log/.../templates/js/files/tests/universal-app.test.js`, which then looks for the template's example files in the host project. All maintained aggregate-runner contracts pass in that same job.

Workaround: invoke Bun with an explicit maintained directory filter. Suggested permanent fix: set `[test] root = "./tests"` in the template configuration (downstream meta-sovereign uses `./js/tests`), replacing the obsolete comment. Keep the existing per-test timeout. Add a bounded regression that copies the real config into an owned temporary fixture with one maintained test and throwing sentinels under `dev/log/` and `dist/`; assert that the maintained test runs and the sentinels never execute. Any test-location policy should distinguish maintained source from deliberately archived references too.

Official documentation: [test.root](https://bun.sh/docs/test/configuration), [discovery rules](https://bun.com/docs/test/discovery). Bun is following its documented default; this is a template configuration gap, not a proposed Bun bug.
title: Scope Bun test discovery to maintained tests; archived reference tests execute in CI
